title: SessionStart runs intake and writes its drafts uncommitted
goal: The async SessionStart hook that runs red-pipeline --hook runs backlog.py intake --file --hook instead: silent, bounded by a timeout, writes draft item files that stay uncommitted until /kb-backlog triage commits them, never commits or pushes; /kb-backlog triage lists intake's uncommitted drafts first; the query log digest counts the week's intake candidates by detector
